scope: Artificial displaced two-He periodic KS-LDA cell: analytic forces, finite-difference and independent-plane-wave checks; not an equilibrium material or a long-time MD validation.
implementation: Original validation/BO-interface workflow backed by PySCF KRKS+FFTDF analytical Gaussian/Pulay and ionic Ewald forces; not a new electronic-structure engine.
force_sign: F_I = -d E_total / d R_I, Cartesian coordinates, including ion-ion Ewald energy.

xc.convention: Dirac exchange plus spin-unpolarized VWN5 correlation

finite_difference.initial_guess: Every displaced SCF starts from the same converged undisplaced density; no displaced energy is reused as a solution.

independent_comparison.scope: Two independently implemented Hamiltonian/SCF/force engines; Libxc functional formulas shared. Different finite Gaussian and plane-wave orbital spaces, no fitted force or energy shifts.

bomd.scope: One step versus two half steps with re-converged electronic forces: local force-provider/velocity-Verlet interface smoke check, not a long-time NVE or physical-material validation.
